description: List available courses, optionally filtered by category and/or level. Sorted by title.

level.description: Optional level filter: beginner | intermediate | advanced.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of course summaries.

description: Retrieve the full course object by cid.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the full course object.

description: Enroll the current user in a course. Fails if already enrolled.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new Enrollment.

description: Remove the current user's enrollment for a course.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is {course_id, unenrolled: true}.

description: List lessons in a course, sorted by order ascending.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of Lesson objects.

description: Get the full lesson body by lsid.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the Lesson object.

description: Mark a lesson as completed. Recomputes progress_percent on the parent enrollment if one exists.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated Lesson.

description: List the current user's enrollments, optionally filtered by completion state.

is_completed.description: Optional filter: True for finished, False for in-progress.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of Enrollment objects.

description: Look up the current user's enrollment for a course.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the Enrollment object.

description: Manually set progress_percent on an enrollment. Automatically flips is_completed at 100%.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated Enrollment.

description: List quizzes, optionally filtered by lesson.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of Quiz objects.
A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the Quiz object.

description: Submit an answer for a quiz. Records a QuizAttempt with correctness.

selected_index.description: Zero-based index into the quiz's options array.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the recorded QuizAttempt.

description: List quiz attempts, optionally filtered by quiz. Sorted by attempted_at desc.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of QuizAttempt objects.

description: Search courses by keyword across title, instructor, description, and category.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of matching course summaries.

description: List enrollments where is_completed is true. Sorted by completed_at desc.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of finished Enrollment objects.

description: Return lesson-based progress details for a course: total_lessons, completed_lessons, progress_percent, enrolled, is_completed.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a progress summary object.

description: Aggregate counts across courses, lessons, enrollments, quizzes, and attempts, grouped by level and category.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is an aggregate stats object.
